changes.text: A fresh start at 0.0.1. holzkube-manager is alpha software under heavy development: any release can change or break features, the API and the data directory's format. Keep a backup of the data directory and read these notes before updating. Everything below is what this first alpha already does.

Clusters and nodes: adopt an existing Talos cluster from its talosconfig or provision a new one. The manager follows the cluster's own membership, so a node that joins or leaves shows up by itself, and every page reads live from the cluster when you open it.
Live hardware per node: load overall and per core, memory, disks, network, temperatures and fans, with the last 24 hours kept across restarts.
Apps: everything that runs on Kubernetes, grouped by what was installed, with its CPU and memory now and over the day, and a page per app with its pods, services and events.
Kubernetes: workloads, pods and why one is broken, events, storage, networking, quotas, who may do what, cordon and drain, applying a manifest and running a command in a container.
Power for a cluster, a node or an app: stop, force stop, start, disable, enable, restart and force restart. Start wakes a switched-off node by Wake-on-LAN.
Talos upgrades built from Image Factory schematics, SecureBoot, disk encryption, etcd snapshots and restore, and certificate renewal.
A wall for a screen in the office: every node and workload as a tile, how full the cluster is, the day's load and the latest warnings.

A local account and single sign-on, roles, a password prompt before anything destructive, a hash-chained audit log and a dry-run mode. holzkubectl on the command line, Prometheus metrics and a support bundle.
A mark of its own: annual rings in a hexagon, as the tab icon, in the sidebar and on a phone's home screen.
